neighbours.label: the second verb of a coordinated instruction: 'do X and <verb> it' (and test it, and explain why)
fire: Build a small paper bridge and test it with a stack of coins.
Read the short poem and explain what the last line means.
Draw a map of your street and label every house on it.
Write a function that reverses a list and test it with an empty list.
Pick a famous invention and explain why it changed daily life.
Mix the two solutions and measure the temperature every minute.
Choose a historical figure and describe how they influenced others.
Plant the seeds in two pots and compare how fast they grow.
quiet: The small paper bridge held a stack of coins without bending.
The short poem ends with a line about the sea.
The map of our street shows every house on it.
This function reverses a list, even an empty list.
That famous invention changed daily life for millions.
The two solutions were mixed in a large glass beaker.
The historical figure in the book was a famous general.
The seeds in the two pots grew at about the same speed.

notes: Card: ' test', ' explain', ' should', ' must', 'set it to start'. Probe: 'write a program and test it' 0.85, 'describe an animal and explain why' 0.37; single-verb instructions and nouns after 'and' stay low.
